title: Truncated variable-depth collimation with fewer source copies

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the variable-depth algorithm of proof.md and variable-profile.md has total sequential work O(2^((71/100) sqrt(n log2 n))), exact growth index 1/2, jointly on every execution branch with the other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 using independent ideal copies.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the variable-depth algorithm of proof.md and variable-profile.md has peak classical bits O(n^2), exact growth index 0, jointly on every execution branch with the other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 using independent ideal copies.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the variable-depth algorithm of proof.md and variable-profile.md has peak qubits O(n), exact growth index 0, jointly on every execution branch with the other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 using independent ideal copies.

For every N>=2 and every s modulo N, with n=ceil(log2 N), the variable-depth algorithm of proof.md and variable-profile.md has total acquired copies O(2^((651/1000) sqrt(n log2 n))), exact growth index 1/2, jointly on every execution branch with the other bounds and unconditional full-secret recovery probability at least 7/8 using independent ideal copies.

For every N>=2 and every s, the same variable-depth algorithm of proof.md and variable-profile.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least 7/8 jointly with all branchwise resource bounds at epsilon(n)=0. Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
